{{recipesummary|category=Beverage recipes|time=30 minutes|difficulty=2}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Beverages|Beverages]] | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Iran|Iranian Cuisine]]

'''Sharbat bil loz''' is an Iranian beverage.

== Ingredients ==  
* 4 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Blanching|blanched]] [[Cookbook:Almond|almonds]]
* 4 cups water
* 3 cups [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]] (optional, it is healthier without sugar)
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Orange Flower Water|orange blossom water]] (or [[Cookbook:Rosewater|rosewater]])

== Procedure ==
# Grind the almonds finely in blender.
# Add the water and continue to grind.
# Strain the liquid through a sieve lined with cheesecloth, reserving the liquid.
# When drained, squeeze the remaining pulp to extract as much liquid as possible. Discard the pulp.
# Pour into a heavy saucepan, then stir in the sugar (optional). 
# Boil, stirring constantly, then lower the heat and simmer very gently for 5–10 minutes.
# Turn off the heat, add the orange flower water, and let the syrup cool. 
# To serve, pour ¼ cup of syrup into a glass, add ice water, and stir well.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Instead of throwing away the almond pulp, you can mix it into almond [[Cookbook:Agar Jelly|agar jelly]].
